verses.1: May the gentle one be satisfied, and may the sad words also be lifted up.
verses.2: For the wise men, wisdom will be revealed; but for the foolish men, their words will be meaningless.
verses.3: In every place, the eyes of Jehovah watch both evil and good.
verses.4: A healer for wounds; a tree that brings life, and its branches can be used to heal wounds in the wind.
verses.5: The lion will take revenge on his father, and he will protect the forest from destruction.
verses.6: The house of the righteous and holy man is blessed, while the home of the wicked is destroyed.
verses.7: The lips of the wise will speak wisdom, but the heart of the foolish will not.
verses.8: The offerings of the wicked are an act of worshiping Jehovah, while the prayers of the righteous are what He desires.
verses.9: The LORD’s wrath will be upon the wicked and those who oppose justice.
verses.10: It’s a bad thing to leave a place that one hates and where death is inevitable.
verses.11: Shaul and Avdon were against Jehovah, even though their hearts were filled with human desires.
verses.12: He will not like it if he is brought before the wise men. He should not go there at all.
verses.13: A cheerful heart brings joy to the face, while a sad heart causes sorrow.
verses.14: The foolish heart seeks knowledge, but their mouths are like those of fools.
verses.15: Every day, both the poor and the good-hearted people always drink from it.
verses.16: It’s better to seek God’s will, rather than to hoard a lot of wealth and possessions.
verses.17: Good is the love of fruits, and hatred is there from Abos.
verses.18: A kind-hearted man will be able to comfort those who are in pain, and his words will bring peace to those who are troubled.
verses.19: The path of those who are righteous is like a path paved with stones and flowers.
verses.20: A wise child will bring joy to his father, but a foolish man will cause sorrow for his mother.
verses.21: Joy for those who have no heart, and a man of wisdom will be saved.
verses.22: Let your thoughts be free from any restrictions, and let many suggestions guide your actions.
verses.23: Joy for a man in his speech and in what he says at that time.
verses.24: A place of living beings, for those who are wise and intelligent, so that they may be able to survive in difficult times.
verses.25: The house of Gaim will be destroyed by Jehovah, and the borders of Almanya will be broken.
verses.26: The LORD’s displeasure comes from evil thoughts and ungodly words.
verses.27: He who destroys his house, who is always in a hurry and hates changes, will live.
verses.28: The heart of a righteous person will be filled with kindness and compassion, while the mouth of the wicked will speak only evil words.
verses.29: May Jehovah be far away from the wicked, and may the prayers of the righteous be heard.
verses.30: In the light of my eyes, there is joy in the heart when I hear good news.
verses.31: She who hears, will find life among the wise ones.
verses.32: He carries the burden of Moses’ death, and he hears the cries of those who are lost.
verses.33: The fear of Jehovah supersedes all wisdom and any kind of honor or glory.
